intro: Squarelinq chair turns simplicity into comfort. Its neat lines, plush cushioning, and warm tone make it a seat that feels as good in daily meals as it does during quiet breaks.

features.title: Clean square design with comfort
features.text: The modern, squared look balances aesthetics with cushioning, giving you structure without sacrificing ease.

features.title: Chocolate fabric that feels inviting
features.text: Rich chocolate brown fabric creates a cozy vibe, adding depth and warmth to your dining or living setup.

features.title: Soft cushioning for relaxed sitting
features.text: Gentle padding makes every sit comfortable, letting you enjoy long meals, reading, or conversations.

features.title: Lightweight build for easy movement
features.text: Move it effortlessly around the room or table, giving you flexibility for guests or changing layouts.

features.title: Durable fabric for daily living
features.text: The fabric finish resists wear while staying soft, keeping its look and feel fresh with regular use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
